title: elaphoglossum squamatum
intro: Elaphoglossum squamatum, commonly known as the scaly elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, respiratory issues, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum squamatum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display cytotoxic effects against certain cancer cells. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, although more research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
